normal: People walking or standing calmly, orderly surroundings, routine activities, peaceful scene.
abuse: A person repeatedly striking or mistreating another person, defensive postures and visible distress.
arrest: Officers restraining a person, holding their arms, applying handcuffs, surrounding a suspect.
arson: A person deliberately igniting material, spreading fire, flames and smoke near a structure.
assault: A person attacking another person, sudden strikes, aggressive gestures and defensive movements.
burglary: Forced entry into a building, damaged doors or windows, intruders searching rooms and removing property.
explosion: A sudden bright flash, flames, thick smoke, flying debris and damaged structures.
fighting: People exchanging punches or kicks, grappling, rapid aggressive movements and defensive postures.
road accident: Vehicles colliding, abrupt stopping, damaged vehicles, scattered debris and disrupted traffic.
car accident: Vehicles colliding, abrupt stopping, damaged vehicles, scattered debris and disrupted traffic.
robbery: Threatening a person while taking belongings, forceful grabbing, weapons and a fleeing attacker.
shooting: A person aiming or firing a gun, muzzle flashes, recoil and people seeking cover.
shoplifting: A person concealing merchandise in clothing or a bag and leaving a shop without paying.
stealing: A person covertly taking another person's property, quickly grasping an item and moving away.
vandalism: A person deliberately damaging property, smashing objects, breaking windows or marking surfaces.
riot: A disorderly crowd, group clashes, objects being thrown, damaged property and chaotic movement.
